No. 2391/26 – WEDNESDAY, JULY 03, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)

Notice Under Section 7 I hereby give notice under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land for a public purpose.

Description of the land to be acquired: All that allotment of land in total extent of about 0.1536 Hectare, depicted as Lot No. 387 in sheet No. 28 in supplement No. 30 in FVP 564 of the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Godakoggala, in Ridiyagama Grama Niladhari Division, in Magam Pattuwa Minor Division, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ambalantota, in Hambantota District, and bounded as follows.

01. Lot No. 387 Name of the land: Bangala Godella, Koggala Bedda, Koggalla Kele; Description of the Land: Road; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Ambalantota Pradeshiya Sabha; Extent: 0.1536 Hectare.

All persons who claim ownership, interest or other connection to the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at 10.30 a.m. on 29th July 2024 at the Divisional Secretariat, Ambalantota. Further, you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing in duplicate on or before 15th July 2024 the nature of their interests in the land , the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land / servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. N.D.P. Ranasinha, Divisional Secretary, Ambalantota. At Divisional Secretariat, Ambalantota. 1st July 2024 EOG 07 - 0026

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)

Notice under Section 7 I hereby give notice under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land for a public purpose.

Description of the land/ servitude to be acquired: All that allotment of land in total extent of about 0.0304 Hectare, depicted as Sheet No. 01 in Block No. 01in the Cadastral Map No. 830224 of the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Thawaluwila, in Puhulyaya Grama Niladhari Division, No. 146, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ambalantota, in Hambantota District, Southern Province and bounded as follows.

01. Lot No. 01 Name of the land: Kachcheriya Watta; Description of the Land: Homestead. A coconut tree of about 02 years old, a lime tree of about 02 years old and a temporary growing is available; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Karandeniya Mahadurage Mallika; Extent: 0.0082 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 02 Name of the land: Kachcheriya Watta; Description of the Land: Homestead. 04 coconut trees of about 05 years old and a temporary growing is available; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Karandeniya Mahadurage Mallika; Extent: 0.0130 Hectare.

03. Lot No. 03 Name of the land: Kachcheriya Watta; Description of the Land: Homestead. A temporary growing is available; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Karandeniya Mahadurage Kamalawathi; Extent: 0.0046 Hectare.

04. Lot No. 04 Name of the land: Kachcheriya Watta; Description of the Land: Homestead. A temporary growing is available; Claimant: Karandeniya Mahadurage Kamalawathi; Original Claimant: Karandeniya Mahadurage Kamalawathi; Extent: 0.0015 Hectare.

05. Lot No. 05 Name of the land: Kachcheriya Watta; Description of the Land: Homestead. A temporary growing is available; Claimant: Karandeniya Shamila Shivanthi; Original Claimant: Karandeniya Shamila Shivanthi; Extent: 0.0031 Hectare. All the persons who claim ownership, interest or any other connection to the aforesaid land/ servitude are

hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at 10.00 a.m. on 05th August 2024 at the Divisional Secretariat, Ambalantota. Further, you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing in duplicate on or before 19th July 2024, the nature of their interests in the land/lands , the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land / servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
N. D. P. Ranasinha, Divisional Secretary, Ambalantota. At Divisional Secretariat, Ambalantota. On 02nd July 2024. EOG 07 - 0027
